review.identity: Mustard headscarf, chestnut hair, olive/ochre clothes retained. Mature female caregiver reads tired, though face became thinner and slightly older than the intended rounded forty-year-old.
review.composition: Chin is too high and too much neck/collar remains; both side silhouettes touch canvas.
review.style: Coarse planes and muted eyes exist, but raised inner brows and face shape still read more anxious/gaunt than practical tired warmth. Dangling side curls remain contrary to desired grouped hair.
review.requested_revision: Wider mature rounded cheek structure and near-level brows/closed mouth; shorten neck, lower chin, retain complete small side margins, consolidate curls into attached temple masses.

approval_scope: Candidate review only; no native or runtime approval
